embedded_webview_policy: msedgewebview2 is observed separately; count need not be zero. Nonzero CPU is disclosed, not silently counted as zero browser rendering. No app process was terminated or suspended by the monitor.
sampling_limits: Endpoint CPU samples omit exited, inaccessible and sub-interval processes; lifetime charge on newly observed browser/webview can overcount boundary CPU. All-process CPU omits new non-browser processes. No affinity, thermal, clock, GPU or exclusive-host guarantee. Regicide sum includes the two comparison engines; no compiler, regression or independent audit runs during play. Names/PIDs are not persisted.
